description:
General Information
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
New in the Original Packaging
What is this Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Rear Brake Cylinders for Suzuki Samurai’s 1985 thru 1988
These are the Hydraulic Cylinders that activate the lever assembly to engage the rear brake shoes
Suzuki OEM Part
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Rear Brake Cylinder RH
Qty 1 – Rear Brake Cylinder LH
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1988 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1988 All Models
